classifications.rationale: Population-level carnivore diet compositions are explicitly organized by site and time. The schema exposes focal carnivore identity, locality, latitude/longitude, dates/seasons, sampling protocol, quantification method and sample-size fields. Sampling comparability and repeated-focal support still require a metadata-only audit.

CropPol exposes field/study/site identities, field coordinates and sampling year, while pollinator sampling metadata expose method, sampled area/time/flowers and abundance. A metadata-only joined support audit is required before any pollinator identity or interaction outcome is opened.

The source integrates multiple parasite-host databases for spatial association analysis. Presence associations and locations do not by themselves define comparable local-network opportunity or standardized sampling needed for rewiring.

GATEWAy compiles food webs and traits across ecosystems and the associated publication already analyzes food-web architecture as a function of predator traits. It can calibrate the pipeline but is not clean fresh generalized evidence.
The source publication explicitly analyzes homogenization of the global plant-frugivore meta-network, so spatial network organization is already outcome-exposed.

Metabarcoding fungal occurrences are linked to dominant plant fields and study samples. These mappings do not establish a standardized realized pairwise host-interaction network suitable for rewiring.
GlobalFungi is an occurrence/metabarcoding database. Dominant vegetation and sample context are not equivalent to observed pairwise biotic interactions or partner opportunity.
The source is a climate-linked AMF spore-trait/biogeography dataset; Host and dominant-plant fields do not define complete repeated local networks with a defensible co-opportunity denominator.
Museum collecting-unit associations have location/date metadata but are opportunistic specimen records rather than standardized local interaction-network samples.
This is a literature catalogue spanning 120 publications with heterogeneous sampling, and the GloBI configuration itself is marked deprecated. It cannot define one comparable spatial rewiring design.

The source has excellent site, effort and time metadata, but the associated paper already analyzes plant-pollinator network diversity. Retain for calibration/transport after a fresh primary system, not as untouched generalized evidence.

The integrated diet/energetics database spans heterogeneous source studies, locations and observation methods. It does not yet provide a common local-network sampling denominator for spatial rewiring.

next_gate: Freeze and run focal-taxon/site/time/sampling-metadata-only support audits for CarniDIET and CropPol. Target partner identities and interaction weights remain sealed.
